title: Greek Lamb Gigantes Plaki
description: A hearty and flavorful Greek dish made with lamb and giant beans in a rich tomato sauce.
instructions: Season the lamb shoulder with salt and black pepper.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set it aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the gigantes beans, diced tomatoes, and tomato sauce to the pot.
Stir to combine and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Return the lamb to the pot and cover it with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and braise the lamb for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Stir in the fresh parsley and serve the lamb and gigantes beans hot.
